title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Incident Response Plan > Severity levels

Level: P1; Meaning: Customer data exposed or full outage; Acknowledge within: 15 minutes
Level: P2; Meaning: Major feature down or suspected exposure; Acknowledge within: 1 hour
Level: P3; Meaning: Degraded service, workaround exists; Acknowledge within: 1 business day
Level: P4; Meaning: Minor issue; Acknowledge within: 3 business days
